about: Main user journeys of the UBTConnect app on TST, the source for end-to-end tests. Format and rules: README.md. Each arrow must be a link in the compiled TST code (survey/screens.json); journey_capture.cjs runs them on TST read-only.

notInAJourney.reason: No way in on TST. In scope with the Orbit family (D6).
No way in on TST. In scope with the LDM family (D6).

journeys.title: Open the app again
journeys.purpose: A user who has a PIN on the device opens the app.
preconditions: Signed in on this device, PIN set, app locked

action.label: The app checks the PIN and opens the PIN screen.

steps.evidence: Splash spec: PIN_Check, then PINRegister or PINUnlock

action.label: Enter the PIN. The app opens the last URL, here the start URL, which shows the home feed.

notes: The run opens the start URL of the app (/UBTConnect/, PWA manifest start_url), as a user does. A tab that opens /UBTConnect/Splash itself keeps Splash as LastURL, so after the PIN the app opens Splash again and locks again (knowledge/shell-facts.md U3).

journeys.title: Sign in for the first time
journeys.purpose: A new user signs in with UBT One and sets a PIN.
preconditions: Not signed in on this device
notes: The UBT One sign-in page is outside the app.

action.label: Login with UBT One, then sign in on the UBT One page.

steps.evidence: Login spec: button 'Login with UBT One'

action.label: Enter and confirm a new PIN. The app opens the home feed.

steps.evidence: PINRegister spec: resume link or LastURL

journeys.title: Accept updated policies
journeys.purpose: A user accepts new terms before using the app.
preconditions: A policy waits for acceptance by the user
journeys.knownBlock: Accepting the policies writes data; the read-only guard blocks it (CLAUDE.md rule 6). The journey needs an account with a pending policy. The last run is from the regional account on 2026-10-21, before the owner accepted its policy on 2026-10-22. Now only the local account has a pending policy.

action.label: The policy checker opens the policies screen when a policy waits for acceptance.
Tick the boxes, then the button. Accepting writes data: the read-only guard blocks it.

journeys.title: Open a share link
journeys.purpose: A user opens a link that another member shared.
preconditions: A share link (ShareId) of a household
notes: The link can also open a Supper Meeting, a OneSchool Global page or a feed item.

action.label: The app reads the link and opens the shared item, here a household.

journeys.knownBlock: The ShareId of the capture plan is a placeholder, so Get_ShareDetails raises a server exception and ConnectShare shows its status message (ConnectShare route spec, states). The journey needs a real share link of a household. Making one is a share, which writes data.

journeys.title: Read community updates
journeys.purpose: A user reads the latest births, marriages and other updates.
notes: The flag C2EnableCarousel is on on TST. Household links open the household carousel.

action.label: Select a member to see the relations.

journeys.knownBlock: Opening an update first marks it as read (ServiceAPIAction_UI_UpdateItem_MarkAsRead), a write that the read-only guard blocks. The stop stays: writes stay blocked; e2e tests on the mock app cover the rest (user, 2026-10-22).

notes: The flag C2EnableCarousel is on on TST. Household links open the household carousel.
preconditions: A household whose name matches the search text

action.label: The search box at the top.
Type a name and press Enter, choose the Households tag, then select a household.

action.label: Open a room, then Guest Arrangements on a guest card.
action.evidence: MilestoneDetail spec §8-9: Guest Arrangements link on a guest card when HasGuestArrangements

journeys.knownBlock: The Orbit event of the test accounts has no transport milestone on days 23 and 24 (only accommodation and meeting cards), so there is no way into TransportDetail (debug snapshots 2026-10-21).

journeys.title: Contact the host
journeys.purpose: A user writes to the host of an Orbit milestone.
notes: The journey stops before Send: sending writes data.
journeys.knownBlock: The milestone of the test accounts is a host accommodation milestone. The host contact email is not on it (MilestoneDetail spec §9: phone popup only), and Email opens the Orbit Helpdesk email (ContactByEmailOrbitHelpdesk, as in J21). The journey needs a guest milestone.

journeys.knownBlock: Observed on TST 2026-10-21: Bookmarks in the bottom bar opens Bookmarks, not MyBookmarks, because C2NewBookmarks is now true on TST (it was false on 2026-10-14). Bookmarks Q1 (user, 2026-10-22): keep MyBookmarks until the PROD value is known. The journey needs an account with C2NewBookmarks off.
